We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. title: Sales Manager -  Nutraceutical Ingredients ( LATAM)
description:
Sales Manager - Nutraceutical Ingredients ( LATAM)


Location: Brazil (Remote)


Territory: Latin America


About the Role


We’re seeking a Sales Manager to drive growth across LATAM. You will sell nutraceutical ingredients to the dietary supplement and functional food & beverage industries, building a high-quality pipeline and long-term customer relationships.


Responsibilities

• Manage and grow key accounts across LATAM, fostering senior-level relationships with brand owners, CDMOs/contract manufacturers, and distributors.

• Develop and execute country- and segment-level territory plans to capture new business.

• Present nutraceutical ingredients to customers, clearly articulating benefits, applications, and go-to-market plans.

• Collaborate with technical, regulatory, and marketing teams to deliver tailored solutions and product launches.

• Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify white space and protect share.

• Meet and exceed quarterly/annual sales targets with accurate forecasting and disciplined CRM hygiene.

• Represent the company at regional trade shows, conferences, and industry events.

• Provide technical/product support to customers in coordination with internal teams.

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of regional regulations and standards (e.g., ANVISA, COFEPRIS, INVIMA).


Requirements

• 5+ years of B2B sales experience in nutraceutical ingredients within LATAM.

• Strong understanding of nutraceutical ingredients and their applications in dietary supplements and functional F&B.

• Proven ability to prospect, build pipelines, negotiate, and close across multiple countries.

• Language: Fluent Portuguese and strong Spanish; English is a plus.

• Self-starter comfortable working remotely; excellent territory/time management.

• Based in Brazil with willingness to travel across LATAM as required.

• Proficiency with MS Office and CRM (ZOHO preferred).

title: Data Warehouse Architect
description:
Databricks Data Warehouse ArchitectAbout the role:

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.

title: Gerente de PLD
description:
Sobre nós


A Kiwify é uma das maiores plataformas de infoprodutos do Brasil, possibilitando que qualquer pessoa crie e venda seus cursos online.


Somos acelerados pela Y Combinator, do Vale do Silício, e hoje já impactamos milhões de usuários.


Agora estamos dando o próximo passo e criando a Conta Digital da Kiwify, que já nasce com alcance massivo e um canal único de distribuição através dos maiores influenciadores do país.


Acreditamos que a Kiwify se tornará uma das maiores contas digitais do Brasil, e queremos pessoas excepcionais para construir essa história com a gente.



Modelo


  • Remoto



Período


  • Segunda à sexta, das 09h às 18h00 (1h de intervalo)



Benefícios


  • VR/VA – R$ 1.000,00 (Flash Benefícios)
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • WellHub – Gympass



Responsabilidades


  • Liderar o time de PLD e Compliance, garantindo processos robustos de prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro, prevenção a fraudes e financiamento ao terrorismo.


  • Desenvolver políticas, normas e procedimentos alinhados às regulamentações do Banco Central e melhores práticas de mercado.


  • Implementar e aprimorar sistemas de monitoramento de transações suspeitas, alertas e relatórios regulatórios.


  • Conduzir investigações internas e análises de clientes, colaboradores, fornecedores e parceiros (KYC, KYE, KYP e Due Diligence).


  • Assegurar a entrega tempestiva e correta de reportes obrigatórios (COAF, Bacen, entre outros).


  • Trabalhar lado a lado com áreas de Risco, Operações e Jurídico para mitigar riscos regulatórios e reputacionais.


  • Fomentar uma cultura de conformidade dentro da empresa, com treinamentos recorrentes e comunicação clara.



Requisitos


  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em posição de liderança em PLD/Compliance em fintechs, bancos ou instituições financeiras.


  • Experiência em desenvolver e implementar políticas, normas e procedimentos de PLD alinhados às exigências regulatórias e melhores práticas internacionais.


  • Conhecimento sólido das regulamentações brasileiras (BACEN, COAF, CVM, SUSEP) e normas internacionais (FATF, OFAC, AMLD).


  • Experiência comprovada em liderar times de PLD, contratar, treinar e desligar profissionais da área.


  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e times de PLD em empresas em rápido crescimento.


  • Forte senso de urgência, responsabilidade e mentalidade hands-on.


  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e com alta capacidade de alinhamento interdepartamental.

description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Legal Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $880-$1,440 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,760-$2,880 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $11 - $18 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.



Job Summary : The Legal Assistant will be responsible for providing comprehensive support to attorneys, performing legal research, drafting documents, and maintaining client files.


Job Tasks :


  • Legal Research and Documentation: Conduct legal research and prepare various legal documents.
  • Case Management : Manage and organize case files and documents.

title: AI Gateway Engineer
description:
AI Gateway Engineer

We are seeking a skilled AI Gateway Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with AI or API gateways, a strong background in backend development, and expertise in deploying and optimizing AI/ML models in a production environment. You will be instrumental in building and scaling our AI infrastructure within an enterprise-grade setting.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and manage AI/API gateways like Kong, Mosaic, or Portkey.
  • Develop and maintain backend services, primarily using Go , with Python as a valuable secondary skill.
  • Optimize and productize AI/ML models for production use, ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Leverage AWS to build and manage our cloud infrastructure.
  • Implement and manage observability tools, including OpenTelemetry (OTel), Grafana, and Prometheus , to monitor system health and performance.
  • Apply prompt engineering techniques to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of AI models.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and deployment of AI solutions.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
  • Proven experience with API or AI gateways (e.g., Kong, Mosaic, Portkey).
  • Strong backend development skills, particularly in Go ; proficiency in Python is a plus.
  • Experience with AI/ML optimization and productization .
  • Expertise in AWS , including its various services for building scalable applications.
  • Familiarity with observability tools like OTel, Grafana, and Prometheus.
  • Practical experience with prompt engineering .
  • A history of working in enterprise-grade environments .


Other Details:
  • Location: Remote (preferred in LATAM region)
  • Length: 1+ Year
  • Client: Gaming Giant

    • The difference between something good and something great is attention to detail – AVM Consulting.

title: Social Seller
description:
OPORTUNIDADE: SOCIAL SELLER (Remoto)


Transforme conexões em vendas reais no mercado digital

Você é apaixonado por redes sociais, sabe se conectar com pessoas de forma genuína e possui habilidade para transformar conversas em vendas?

Busca crescimento rápido, gosta de desafios e quer atuar ao lado de grandes experts do mercado digital?

Então essa vaga é para você.



Sobre a RedSuit

Na RedSuit, acreditamos que toda venda começa com um relacionamento verdadeiro.

Somos especialistas em potencializar resultados por meio de estratégias modernas de Social Selling — e agora buscamos alguém com energia, foco e vontade de crescer para integrar nosso time.


O que faz um Social Seller?

O Social Seller é responsável por conduzir vendas sociais por meio de interações estratégicas nas redes (Instagram, LinkedIn e outros canais).

Na prática, você atuará como um “clone digital” do expert, construindo relações, nutrindo leads e convertendo seguidores em clientes.


Responsabilidades Principais
  • Dar boas-vindas e engajar novos seguidores via Direct do Instagram
  • Construir e nutrir relacionamentos com leads qualificados
  • Fechar vendas diretamente ou agendar reuniões para Closers/Experts
  • Registrar e acompanhar todas as interações no CRM (Kommo)
  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos para maximizar conversões
  • Gerar relatórios diários de performance e indicadores
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e estratégia



O que esperamos de você
  • Experiência prévia em vendas — preferencialmente no digital (infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos)
  • Excelente comunicação: clara, empática e persuasiva
  • Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente
  • Foco em metas, mentalidade de crescimento e resiliência
  • Equipamentos adequados para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular)



O que oferecemos

Salário fixo + comissões agressivas (ganhe proporcional à sua performance)

Treinamento personalizado com nosso Head de Vendas

title: Desenvolvimento Java + Kotlin AWS Sênior - 125663
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Desenvolvimento Java + Kotlin AWS


Requisitos:

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Java experiente e com sólidos conhecimentos em Amazon Web Services (AWS) para se juntar à nossa equipe de tecnologia. O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações robustas e escaláveis em Java, integrando-as com serviços na nuvem AWS. Procuramos alguém com paixão por tecnologia, habilidades em resolver problemas complexos e experiência em ambientes de nuvem. Responsabilidades: Desenvolver, testar e manter aplicações back-end em Java 17+ e Kotlin, assegurando alta performance e escalabilidade. Projetar e implementar soluções em AWS, utilizando serviços como: Mensageria com Kafka e SQS, Serverless com Lambda e Step Functions, DevOps com GitHub Actions e Terraform, Cloud AWS: DynamoDB, Step Functions, Lambda, ECS, ECR, S3, SQS, SNS, Batch, Glue, Observabilidade com Datadog, Grafana e Prometheus Integrar as aplicações Java com a infraestrutura na nuvem, garantindo eficiência e segurança. Colaborar com a equipe de DevOps para automatizar processos de build, deploy e monitoramento utilizando CI/CD e outras ferramentas. Garantir a qualidade do código por meio de práticas como revisão de código, testes automatizados e aplicação de design patterns. Monitorar, otimizar e manter os serviços e recursos AWS para garantir alta disponibilidade e custo-benefício. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outros desenvolvedores e stakeholders para alinhar requisitos de negócio com soluções técnicas. Participar ativamente em todas as fases do ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software, desde a concepção até a produção. Requisitos: Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com Java 17+/Kotlin, incluindo frameworks como Spring, Spring boot, Hibernate ou Java EE. Proficiência em AWS, com experiência prática em serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, IAM, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, SSM entre outros. Conhecimento em arquitetura de microsserviços e práticas de desenvolvimento orientado a serviços (SOA


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:


Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

Salários competitivos;

Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

Gympass;

Previdência Privada;

Auxílio-Creche;

Assistência Médica;

Assistência Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida.


Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Data Enginee r who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Extensive experience (5+ years) working as a Data Engineer, with a strong focus on AWS technologies and serverless architectures;

- Experience working as a Data Engineer, with focus on Azure is valuable;

- In-depth knowledge of AWS services such as S3, Lambda, Glue, Athena, Redshift, and DynamoDB, and their capabilities for building scalable data processing systems;

- Proven expertise in designing and implementing AWS serverless architectures for large-scale data processing and storage;

- Strong programming skills in languages like Python, Java, or Scala, along with experience using SQL for data manipulation and querying;

- Hands-on experience with data integration and ETL tools, such as AWS Glue or Apache Spark, for transforming and processing data;

- English

Familiarity with data modeling techniques and data warehousing concepts, including star and snowflake schemas;

- Solid understanding of data security, access control, and compliance requirements in a data-driven environment;

- Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and the ability to collaborate with analysts and data scientists to deliver actionable insights;

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a detail-oriented approach to ensure data accuracy and integrity;

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment

Key responsibilities:

Design and implement an AWS Serverless DataLake architecture to efficiently handle large volumes of data and support various data processing workflows;

- Develop data ingestion pipelines and data integration processes, ensuring the smooth and reliable transfer of data from various sources into the DataLake;

- Implement data transformation and data enrichment processes using AWS Lambda, Glue, or similar serverless technologies to ensure data quality and consistency;

- Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand their data requirements and design appropriate data models and schemas in the DataLake;

- Optimize data storage and retrieval mechanisms, leveraging AWS services such as S3, Athena, Redshift, or DynamoDB, to provide high-performance access to the data;

- Monitor and troubleshoot the DataLake infrastructure, identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, data processing errors, and other issues;

- Continuously evaluate new AWS services and technologies to enhance the DataLake architecture, improve data processing efficiency, and drive innovation;

- Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior data engineers, fostering their growth and ensuring adherence to best practices;

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, prioritize tasks, and deliver high-quality solutions within defined timelines

Data lake, aws, spark, python

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.

### **What You’ll Get**

- Competitive compensation in USD.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software Backend - Sênior (Python)
description:
O seu papel como Software Engineer Senior (E3)

  • Desenvolver soluções de ponta a ponta em Python , desde a definição de arquitetura até testes e rollout em produção;
  • Projetar e evoluir sistemas com foco em automação , direcionados à eficiência operacional do grupo SBF;
  • Garantir funcionalidade, manutenibilidade, escalabilidade e qualidade , aplicando boas práticas de engenharia e testes;
  • Trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo, com pair programming, feedbacks contínuos e cultura de alta performance .


O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo

  • Proficiência avançada em Python (orientação a objetos, concorrência, boas práticas de código);
  • Experiência com arquiteturas distribuídas e microsserviços;
  • Conhecimento em Docker & Kubernetes para implantação escalável de modelos e serviços;
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade e monitoramento aplicados a sistemas de IA e automação;
  • Sólida prática em testes unitários, integração e validação de modelos;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente multifuncional e colaborativo , com autonomia;
  • Embasamento teórico em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina e boas práticas de engenharia de software (DDD, design de código, paradigmas);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).


Seria legal se você conhecesse

  • Google Cloud AI/ML Services (Vertex AI, AI Platform);
  • Continuous Integration & Delivery aplicados a ML (CI/CD para pipelines de dados e modelos);
  • Ferramentas de processamento de dados em streaming (Kafka, Pub/Sub);
  • Boas práticas de DataOps e integração com times de dados e automação.

title: Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID 121504
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID


Requisitos:

Esse vaga precisa de inglês Avançado . VAGA COM INGLÊS FLUENTE Engenheiro de dados Gestão de estruturas de dados, definição de modelos e padrões logidos de dados como unica fonte de informação (data lake com governança de dados ); Experiencia em arquitetura de Dados; Desenvolvimento Python; Experiencia em coleta, transformação e carga de dados (ferramentas de ETL ); Experiência em trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados; Modelagem de Banco de Dados (SQL, Hadoop, MySQL, Redshift, ); Conhecimento em bancos NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB ); Integração de dados com outros sistemas Plataforma AWS; Experiência em workloads de missão crítica; Containers (Docker, ECS, Kubernetes, EKS Openshift); DevOps (Gitlab; Gitlab CI, Puppet); Cloudformation (Code Build, CodePipeline) Softwares Necessários: API Gateway . Kafka . AWS Lake Formation . AWS Banco de Dados (Redshift, MySQL, Dynam DB,..) . AWS Athena . AWS GLUE ( Crawlers, Jobs, workflow) . AWS Quick Sigth . AWS EMR . AWS Lambda.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:


Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

Salários competitivos;

Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

Gympass;

Previdência Privada;

Auxílio-Creche;

Assistência Médica;

Assistência Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida.


Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Data Enginner w/ Databricks  (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are we looking for?

  • At least 4 years of professional experience as a Data Engineer;
  • At least 3 years of professional experience with Databricks and Python;
  • Fluent in both spoken and written English - (B2 or above - Mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: hybrid;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase?

We are waiting for you!


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

(please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.


Essential Skills

  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

ID:

title: LATAM Business Development Representative
description:
About Prometheus Group

Prometheus Group is a team of self-starters centered on being resourceful, accountable, and results-focused. Career progress is based on merit and not years of service or attaining certifications. Our drive and dedication to creating great products for our global customers are at the heart of all we do! In joining Prometheus, you will become a part of the largest global provider of comprehensive enterprise asset management (EAM) software solutions that support the management life cycle for equipment maintenance and operations.


Job Summary

Do you love the thrill of victory? Are you interested in a path to success? Then the Business Development Representative role at Prometheus Group is your job! Business Development Representatives immediately affect the overall pipeline and growth of our company. With the advanced sales tactics that we institute, you will not only be an integral part of our sales process but also contribute to our overall bottom line. The Business Development Representative role is the backbone of our successful LATAM sales team, and we want you to be a part of that!


At Prometheus Group, we live and breathe off a meritocracy-based promotion system. Promotions are not based on tenure but based on the ability & talent you possess within this role. Business Development Representatives will have opportunities to progress into different paths, such as Account Management or Team Management.


Your role will be to seek new business opportunities by contacting and developing relationships with potential clients, so ambition is a top priority when looking for the perfect candidate. You will use your communication skills to cultivate strong relationships with prospects from the first contact until you qualify the opportunity. Do you think you have what it takes? Submit your resume today!



Responsibilities

  • Maintain high call volume daily (80-100 calls)
  • Develop leads in cold and warm prospect accounts to generate interest in our solutions.
  • Gather prospects' needs and understand their initiatives related to our solutions.
  • Discover new software opportunities by calling targeted prospect accounts
  • Generate a steady flow of qualified opportunities each month
  • Develop and deliver high-level product presentations to new clients.
  • Participate in the development of accounts, prospect profiling, and sales cycles.
  • Collaborate with experienced account managers when prospecting accounts and creating opportunities.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Fluent in Spanish and Portuguese
  • High-energy self-starter who can learn quickly and engage clients
  • 1+ years of cold calling experience preferred
  • Ambition to grow and build a career in sales
  • Ability to resonate with the prospect's situation and detect needs
  • Positive and energetic phone skills
  • Customer-focused, results-driven with excellent interpersonal skills
  • Salesforce experience is a plus


Prometheus Group is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.

O que estamos procurando:

  • Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
  • Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
  • Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Recruiter I
description:
Somos fanáticos por nossas pessoas! E demonstramos isso oferecendo uma cultura de pertencimento; caminhos claros para o desenvolvimento de carreira; programas de apoio profissional, coaching e mentoria, uma rede global de amigos e colegas que podem te suportar e mais! (Tipo, muito mais.).


Quer estar em uma multinacional que é Great Place to Work, apoiar as melhores marcas do mercado, inovar e mudar o mundo – tudo ao mesmo tempo em que estabelece conexões reais com as pessoas e desenvolve sua carreira?


Seja um #gamechanger Junte-se ao nosso time e vamos tornar isso oficial!

Todas as vagas da Concentrix vagas são elegíveis a Pessoas com Deficiência.


Estamos procurando por um(a) Recruiter I.


O que você fará:


• Responsável por auxiliar na implementação e administração de programas de recrutamento.

• Receber, selecionar e arquivar currículos.

• Conduzir entrevistas de triagem inicial, entrevistas por telefone e/ou entrevistas presenciais com candidatos em potencial.

• Seguir com as ofertas da vaga de acordo com a descrição da conta.

• Acompanhar o candidato desde o processo seletivo até a data de início na empresa.

• Utilizar diversos recursos - internet, organizações comunitárias, mídia impressa, redes formais/informais, faculdades, associações comerciais - para buscar candidatos qualificados, direta e indiretamente.

• Manter padrões consistentes para todos os candidatos e garantir a conformidade com todas as regras e regulamentos locais relacionados à contratação e recrutamento.

• Responsável por desenvolver e aplicar um conhecimento profundo das especificações do cargo, incluindo experiência, habilidades e competências comportamentais necessárias para o sucesso em cada função.

• Promover a imagem da empresa para candidatos e prestadores de serviços externos e garantir que a Empresa é representada da forma mais precisa e apropriada para todos os candidatos e impulsiona pessoalmente os mais altos padrões de comportamento ético para todos os envolvidos nos processos de recrutamento.


Se você possui:


• Um ano de experiência relevante com volumetria;

• Ensino superior cursando ou completo (Administração, Psicologia ou Gestão de Recursos Humanos);

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, tanto escrita quanto verbal;

• Capacidade de realizar múltiplas tarefas, priorizar e cumprir prazos de entrega;

• Proficiência em Microsoft Office;

• Autoiniciativa, senso de urgência, trabalha bem sob pressão, capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes de alta velocidade;

• Senso de profissionalismo e capacidade de desenvolver relacionamentos;

• Grande atenção aos detalhes;

• Capacidade de lidar e manter informações confidenciais.


Aqui é o seu lugar!


O que oferecemos:


• Oportunidade de carreira e desenvolvimento;

• Seguro de vida;

• Plano de Saúde

• Vale-Refeição e/ou Vale-alimentação;

• Vale-transporte;

• Auxílio creche;

• Plataforma online com diversos cursos disponíveis;

• Parceria com diversas Universidades e Escolas de idiomas.


Local de trabalho: Centro - Curitiba

Horário de trabalho: Seg à Sex das 08h00 às 17:48.

title: Senior Benefits Manager LATAM
description:
The Senior Benefits Manager – Latin America will lead the strategy, design, and management of employee benefits programs across the Latin American region for a global technology company. This role ensures our benefits offerings are competitive, scalable, compliant, and aligned with our mission to attract and retain world-class talent.

You’ll serve as a trusted regional expert—partnering closely with Global Rewards, regional and local HR, Finance, Legal, Operations—to create an exceptional employee experience that reflects our culture of innovation, agility, and wellbeing.


Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive benefits strategy that supports the company’s growth and employee value proposition across Latin America.
  • Act as the regional thought leader on benefits trends, market practices, and digital innovations in the Global Rewards space.
  • Collaborate with Global Rewards and HR leadership to ensure benefits design aligns with global benefits strategy and vision.
  • Consult and guide the benefits team members as well as our brokers on the strategy and objectives for the benefits function overall.

Program Design & Management

  • Design and manage benefits programs—including health, retirement, life, disability, and wellbeing—across multiple Latin American markets (e.g., Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Chile, Peru).
  • Drive scalability and efficiency through regional harmonization, technology enablement, and vendor consolidation where appropriate.
  • Lead annual renewals, plan design changes, and benchmarking in partnership with global brokers and local consultants.
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and performance metrics to ensure best-in-class service delivery.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with local regulations, labor laws, and reporting requirements.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Payroll, and Finance to maintain robust governance and operational accuracy.
  • Monitor legislative developments and assess their impact on program design and cost.

Employee Experience & Engagement

  • Develop compelling communication strategies that help employees understand and value their benefits.
  • Partner with internal communications, HR, and local teams to integrate benefits into broader employee experience and wellbeing initiatives.
  • Champion wellbeing, inclusivity, and flexibility in benefits programs to meet the diverse needs of our workforce.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Leverage data and market insights to drive benefits strategy and cost management decisions.
  • Track and report key metrics related to participation, utilization, and employee satisfaction.
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and digital transformation to enhance efficiency and employee experience.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience with a leadership position managing employee benefits in a multi-country regional role across Latin America.
  • Proven success in benefits management within a highly matrixed, high-growth technology or multinational environment.
  • Deep understanding of regional benefits practices, legislation, and market dynamics.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
  • Strong teamwork, analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.


Preferred Skills & Attributes

  • Passion for innovation, technology, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience with HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors).
  • Skilled at balancing strategic vision with hands-on execution.
  • Culturally fluent and adept at influencing across diverse teams.
  • Commitment to creating inclusive, employee-centered benefits programs.

title: Java/Golang Developer
description:
Work on backend components for enterprise-scale headend applications in the media domain. You will develop and maintain cloud-based microservices supporting high-volume workflows.


Responsibilities:

  • - Implement backend services using Java and Golang.
  • - Develop APIs and integrate event-driven systems.
  • - Participate in Agile development and CI/CD processes.
  • - Support operational tasks and troubleshoot issues.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • - Experience in Java and Golang development.
  • - Knowledge of microservices architecture and API design.
  • - Familiarity with AWS services (Lambda, S3).
  • - Basic understanding of Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines.


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • - Python scripting.
  • - Exposure to SQL/NoSQL databases.


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Business Developer for Social Media
description:
As Blueclip, we started our journey to bring the most creative minds and the know-how together to deliver great works. Our current search is a Business Developer for identifying and developing strategic opportunities across major social media platforms.


This role sits at the intersection of business development, content partnerships, and M&A opportunities within the creator economy.


As a Business Developer, you will be responsible for identifying high-potential content channels, engaging with creators and channel owners, evaluating monetization opportunities, and structuring commercial partnerships that support our company’s growth strategy.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify high-revenue potential YouTube, Facebook, and Snapchat channels aligned with the business goals
  • Engage with content creators and/or channel owners to assess the value and potential of their channels
  • Develop and present commercial proposals to creators and channel owners
  • Onboard new partners (creators or channel owners) into the company’s operational processes
  • Explore and analyze new opportunities across social platforms to accelerate company growth
  • Collaborate closely with platform managers, the data/strategy team, and company executives (CEOs) to align business opportunities with strategic priorities


Ideal Candidate Profile:

  • Excellent English communication skills, written and spoken
  • Strong understanding of the creator economy and social media content monetization
  • Genuine interest in digital content and the evolution of social platforms
  • Proven negotiation and deal-making abilities
  • Ability to craft compelling commercial offers and proposals
  • Strong autonomy, organization, and project management skills
  • Experience in business development, partnerships, or M&A related to digital media or entertainment


If you think everything suits you, hit the apply button!


Please upload your updated CV in English!

  • Ability to craft compelling commercial offers and proposals

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de um Full Stack Developer Senior para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas brasileiros. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.


Somos uma empresa jovem, mas muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver novas funcionalidades utilizando ReactJS e APIs RESTful, utilizando Node.js e Express;
  • Escrever códigos limpos, de alta qualidade e fácil manutenção seguindo as boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Realizar code reviews, ajudando outros desenvolvedores a melhorar a qualidade do código;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de tecnologia (Engenharia, Produto e Design) para o sucesso dos projetos;
  • Participar ativamente em discussões de arquitetura e tecnologias;
  • Realizar code reviews, ajudando outros desenvolvedores a melhorar a qualidade do código;
  • Garantir que a documentação do código e arquitetura esteja sempre atualizada.
  • Requisitos técnicos:
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de Backend e Frontend;
  • Experiência em Typescript e API REST;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais;
  • Orquestração de containers (Docker e docker-compose);
  • Conhecimento em Styled Components e Context API;
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git.


Desejável:

  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência em times de desenvolvimento de software ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e ferramentas de integração contínua;
  • Conhecimento de Design Patterns;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação;
  • Boa habilidade de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico.


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

Cartão flexível de benefícios.

Rotina de trabalho híbrido;

Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;

Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Se você é um Desenvolvedor Full Stack com boa experiência em desenvolvimento de software está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se candidate na oportunidade.

title: Vendedor
description:
Vaga para Vendedora em Clínica de Transplante Capilar

Você é apaixonada por vendas e deseja atuar em um mercado em crescimento? Venha fazer parte da nossa equipe!

Estamos em busca de uma vendedora dedicada para integrar nossa clínica especializada em transplante capilar. Se você tem facilidade de comunicação, gosta de desafios e está em busca de uma oportunidade que valorize seu potencial, essa vaga é para você!


Responsabilidades:

- Atendimento ao cliente, fornecendo informações detalhadas sobre os serviços de transplante capilar.

- Prospecção de novos clientes e manutenção de um bom relacionamento com os já existentes.

- Acompanhamento de todas as etapas do processo de vendas, garantindo a satisfação do cliente.

- Fechamento de vendas e acompanhamento pós-venda.

- Cumprimento das metas estabelecidas pela equipe de vendas.


Requisitos:

- Experiência prévia em vendas, preferencialmente no ramo da saúde ou estética.

- Habilidade de comunicação e persuasão.

- Foco em resultados e superação de metas.

- Proatividade, organização e comprometimento.


O que oferecemos:

- *Salário fixo*  compatível com o mercado.

- *Comissão atrativa *:

- *Vale transporte* e *vale alimentação*.

- Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e de fácil acesso.

- Oportunidade de crescimento dentro da empresa.

Horário de trabalho:

Segunda a sexta-feira das 9h às 18h

Sábado das 9h às 13h

Se você está pronta para se juntar a um time vencedor e ajudar nossos clientes a alcançarem os resultados dos sonhos, envie seu currículo e venha conquistar grandes resultados com a gente!

*Vem ser nossa estrela!*

Vaga para Vendedora em Clínica de Transplante Capilar

Você é apaixonada por vendas e deseja atuar em um mercado em crescimento? Venha fazer parte da nossa equipe!

Estamos em busca de uma vendedora dedicada para integrar nossa clínica especializada em transplante capilar. Se você tem facilidade de comunicação, gosta de desafios e está em busca de uma oportunidade que valorize seu potencial, essa vaga é para você!


Responsabilidades:

- Atendimento ao cliente, fornecendo informações detalhadas sobre os serviços de transplante capilar.

- Prospecção de novos clientes e manutenção de um bom relacionamento com os já existentes.

- Acompanhamento de todas as etapas do processo de vendas, garantindo a satisfação do cliente.

- Fechamento de vendas e acompanhamento pós-venda.

- Cumprimento das metas estabelecidas pela equipe de vendas.


Requisitos:

- Experiência prévia em vendas, preferencialmente no ramo da saúde ou estética.

- Habilidade de comunicação e persuasão.

- Foco em resultados e superação de metas.

- Proatividade, organização e comprometimento.


O que oferecemos:

- *Salário fixo*  compatível com o mercado.

- *Comissão atrativa *:

- *Vale transporte* e *vale alimentação*.

- Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e de fácil acesso.

- Oportunidade de crescimento dentro da empresa.

Horário de trabalho:

Segunda a sexta-feira das 9h às 18h

Sábado das 9h às 13h

Se você está pronta para se juntar a um time vencedor e ajudar nossos clientes a alcançarem os resultados dos sonhos, envie seu currículo e venha conquistar grandes resultados com a gente!

*Vem ser nossa estrela!*

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a DevOps Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, and security by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. The DevOps engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization. This role plays a fundamental role in driving the adoption of cloud platform capabilities in collaboration with software engineering, architecture, and information security teams


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Deploy & Configure AWS Cloud Services;
  • Deploy & Configure Kubernetes resources;
  • Help elaborating or contributing to RFC and ADRs documents describing technical solutions;
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) – Automate infrastructure deployment;
  • CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions;
  • Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
  • Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
  • Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.



Essential Skills

  • Experience in a DevOps role, with hands-on AWS experience;
  • Experience with IaC tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;
  • Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI and GithubActions;
  • Experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC);
  • Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments;
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills;
  • Familiarity with Ruby or Golang;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Shell, or Python).



Highly Desirable Skills

  • Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
  • Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, CloudWatch;
  • Experience with Kubernetes packet managers (e.g. Helm, Kubectl);
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About Turnkey

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software.

The TurnKey team is growing fast and worldwide! We have employees located in Eastern European countries and Latin America (Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Uruguay). We continue scaling remote software development teams for more than 30+ US-based enterprises and start-ups, including Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, Ironclad, BellXcel, etc. At TurnKey, we’re the ultimate matchmakers for US-based companies, creating remote dream teams.


Role Overview

We’re looking for a driven and detail-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our growing team. You will play a key role in sourcing and recruiting top tech and non-tech talent across Europe and Latin America , partnering closely with hiring managers and candidates to ensure an excellent recruitment experience from start to finish.


Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with internal teams and clients to understand hiring needs and role requirements
  • Source, screen, and engage candidates for a variety of technical and non-technical roles
  • Manage full-cycle recruitment: job posting, sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, collecting feedback, and offer negotiation
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for high-demand positions
  • Ensure a smooth and timely candidate experience, keeping stakeholders informed throughout the process
  • Collaborate with team members and hiring managers to continuously improve processes
  • Maintain accurate data in our applicant tracking systems and internal reports
  • Stay updated on regional hiring trends and market insights across Europe and LATAM


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles.
  • Strong knowledge of IT roles, technologies, and industry trends.
  • Familiarity with both technical and non-technical profiles
  • Solid sourcing skills and experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and other sourcing tools
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Experience hiring in Latin America
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
  • Upper-Intermediate + level of English
  • Readiness to work in various time zones according to the candidates’ time zone


Why You Should Work at TurnKey:

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team.
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks);
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Free advanced English lessons with a budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work;
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes.
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together.
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise.
